# Northwind Telecom — Roaming FAQ

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## National roaming

National roaming is included on every plan at no charge. A connection works anywhere in India on the
same allowance, and calls made while roaming inside India are charged exactly as calls made at home.

## International roaming

International roaming is off by default and must be switched on from the app at least four hours
before departure. It cannot be switched on from outside India.

## International roaming packs

| Pack | Price | Validity | Data | Voice |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Neighbour 7 | ₹999 | 7 days | 5 GB | 100 minutes |
| Global 10 | ₹2,999 | 10 days | 10 GB | 200 minutes |
| Global 30 | ₹5,999 | 30 days | 30 GB | 500 minutes |

A pack's validity starts when it is applied, not when you land. Incoming calls while abroad are
included in a pack's voice minutes.

## Without a pack

Pay-as-you-go roaming is charged at ₹5 per MB, ₹75 per outgoing minute and ₹50 per incoming minute.
A daily spend cap of ₹5,000 applies, after which data stops and calls continue.

## Which networks you get

The handset selects a partner network automatically. A specific partner can be chosen manually in
the handset's network settings, but a network that is not a Northwind partner will refuse the
connection.

## Cruise ships and aircraft

Networks on ships and aircraft are not partner networks and are not covered by any pack. They are
barred by default; unbar them from the app if you intend to use them, and expect charges set by the
onboard operator rather than by Northwind.

## Coming home

International roaming switches itself off 24 hours after the handset first registers on an Indian
network again, so a forgotten setting does not cost anything on the next trip.
